title: Remove duplicates with HashSet
description: Given an array of names with duplicates, use a HashSet to remove the repeated ones and print the unique names.
hints: Create a HashSet<String> and add each name to it
Use add() for each element of the array
solutionExplanation: We create a HashSet and add each name. The Set automatically ignores duplicates. In the end only the 4 unique names remain.

title: Word counter with LinkedHashMap
description: Given an array of words, count how many times each one appears using a LinkedHashMap and preserving the order of first appearance.
solutionExplanation: LinkedHashMap preserves the order in which the words appear. getOrDefault() obtains the current count (0 if it does not exist) and adds 1. Finally we iterate over the entries.

title: Phone book with TreeMap
description: Create a phone book using TreeMap so that contacts always appear sorted alphabetically. Add contacts, search one by name and show all sorted.
hints: TreeMap<String, String> sorts automatically by key
Iterate with forEach to show all
solutionExplanation: TreeMap sorts the keys alphabetically automatically (Ana, Beatriz, Carlos). get() searches a contact by name. entrySet() iterates in alphabetical order.
expectedOutput:
Carlos' phone: 555-0202

All contacts:
Ana -> 555-0101
Beatriz -> 555-0303
Carlos -> 555-0202
